# 0062 — Tracked-in-`HEAD` Binary Deliverables for Immediate Author Access & First-Mention Character Introduction Gate (`2026-10-21`)

## Plain-English Summary
1. **Commit Author-Facing `.docx`/`.pdf` Deliverables into `HEAD` (`git add -f`) Before Launching `steward_code_job.py`:** Deleting untracked `.docx`/`.pdf` files before `steward_code_job.py start` prevents the `"exists in worktree, not in HEAD"` lander error, **but** leaves the file temporarily missing from disk while the background code job runs. By force-adding (`git add -f`) and committing the compiled `.docx`/`.pdf`/`.html`/`.md` outputs into `HEAD` before calling `steward_code_job.py start`, the author can download and edit the `.docx` immediately from disk AND Anchor's lander updates the tracked file cleanly upon completion.
2. **First-Mention Character Introduction & Local-Scene Consistency Gate (`Seat 3` & `Seat 6`):** In `20261021-133350-606b1b`, the cross-family Claude reviewer caught 8 subtle micro-continuity bugs in `CHAPTERS-06-TO-08-MANUSCRIPT-v2.md`: (a) `ct`'s internal narration in Scene 7.2 (`L489`) mentioned `"Agent Riley"` by name before Riley was introduced to the kids in Scene 7.5 (`L647`); (b) Dr. Lin said `"Pick up your chair, Mr. Patel"` (`L609`) when it was `Zara`'s chair that tipped over (`L581`); (c) Anya reversed the Mon/Wed/Fri vs. Tue/Thu Stratum weekday schedule from Chapter 5 (`L119`); (d) Abigail rode the `F` train straight to `57th Street` instead of transferring with `ct` and Jess at `West Fourth Street` to the uptown `B` train (`L99`); and (e) `L621` said `"after eighth period"` right after `L619` said `"after seventh period"`. All 8 are now enforced deterministically in `check_ch678_manuscript_v2.py`.
